three_beats.title: A Very Generous Guest
three_beats.action: HMB arrives as a celebrant with a large wrapped present; Duckhook welcomes the apparently generous guest. Establish the gift table, birthday chair, separate cake and party sightlines.
three_beats.copy: Dr. Duckhook had filled Jackson’s dining hall with cakes, streamers and people prepared to make a fuss over him. Outside, the windows trembled. Inside, the lamps stayed golden. His Majesty’s Blood arrived carrying a present large enough to deserve its own table. Duckhook welcomed him with the confidence of a host who believed every surprise in the room had been arranged for his benefit.

three_beats.title: The 200 Burger
three_beats.action: Duckhook opens HMB’s present and reveals the giant 200 Burger. The burger remains in the open box while HMB turns toward the separately established cake.
three_beats.copy: The ribbon came away. Then the lid. A towering double-decker hamburger filled the box, its little flag announcing 200 BURGER. Duckhook’s smile held for an ambitious second. Around him, the room began to understand. His Majesty’s Blood had brought something generous, personal and impossible to return. The birthday boy was still deciding what to say when the champion reached toward the cake.

three_beats.title: Many Unhappy Returns
three_beats.action: HMB deliberately smears the separate birthday cake into Duckhook’s face. Cake contact and frosting make the public humiliation clear; the burger remains a separate intact prop. No combat, fall or table collapse occurs.
three_beats.copy: His Majesty’s Blood pressed the cake into Duckhook’s face before the birthday boy found his speech. Frosting spread across white feathers and orange bill as the dining hall erupted around them. The champion’s belt caught the warm light beside the open present. The 200 Burger remained magnificent. The birthday boy needed a towel.

story.premise: Mud has already watched this landscape betray his knowledge under Niño’s weather. As the broader front passes, he chooses the remaining route he trusts. Slob takes that ground away through size, footing and constant pressure.
